refnamediv.refpurpose: This function returns a Gaussian convolution window.

listitem.para: output variable, vector of real numbers

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: This function returns a Gaussian convolution window of length m supplied as input, to the output vector w. The second parameter is the width measured in sample rate/number of samples and should be f for time domain and 1/f for frequency domain. The width is inversely proportional to a.
